function.name: cancel_booking
function.description: Cancel an existing appointment, found by the phone number it was booked with and its start time. Only call this after the caller has confirmed which appointment to cancel.

phone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked with, all digits.

start_time.description: Start time of the appointment in Skopje local time, format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, for example 2026-11-23T14:00.
